families.signature_zh: 左手释放马蹄后明显抬高并绕回抓环，换抓路线形成较大的回环。
families.qualification: existing_seed_kinematics; existing route separation is strong

families.signature_zh: 侧面扫入，采用较平滑的大弧路线；重点强化右手重新支撑时的外侧通道。
families.qualification: existing_seed_kinematics; strengthen separation from F3 before macro release

families.signature_zh: 右手先退让、再调整腕姿并回到支撑抓点，保留分段接近特征；与 F2 使用不同的接近通道。
families.qualification: existing_seed_kinematics; strengthen separation from F2 before macro release

appearances.geometry_reference: the chosen family existing paired scene
appearances.observable_zh: 保留原经典马蹄与圆形目标环，作为动作比较的共同基准。
appearances.ik_adaptation_zh: 复用该 family 的已验证 IK 种子；若调整宏观路线，则重新验证。

appearances.name_zh: 宽体 U 形大轮廓
appearances.observable_zh: 使用较方的 U 形原型并整体增大 18%，同一相机下轮廓体量明显更大；当前 U 形本身仍为温和变形。
appearances.ik_adaptation_zh: 按真实带状表面重建马蹄抓点和夹爪开度，重新求双臂 IK；抓距增大不能靠缩放关节角实现。

appearances.observable_zh: 目标环具有明确长短轴，并出现有作用的相位调整动作；在目标环正视图中验收椭圆形状。
appearances.ik_adaptation_zh: 重建椭圆表面接触坐标与切向；把额外转环安排到可控制目标环的阶段，必要时增加受支撑的换抓子阶段。

visual_acceptance.macro_route_comparison: Remove initial similarity, preserve hand identity, compare equal arc-length samples within corresponding stages

space_rules.geometry_limits_policy: Use only a certificate-backed neighborhood of the chosen family/appearance pair; do not take a Cartesian product of global extrema
space_rules.wide_appearance_anchors: Require independent geometric path plus a newly validated robot pairing before becoming sampleable
space_rules.small_geometry_jitter: May inherit a geometric perturbation bound, but does not inherit robot/grasp validity
space_rules.ring_phase_control_rule: Do not prescribe independent target-ring rotation while both hands are committed to the shoes without a demonstrated control/support mechanism
space_rules.inverse_scene_rule: Infer scene only within a geometry/grasp hypothesis, and require both arms to reconstruct consistent object poses

robot: robot/puzzle/table collision checks with explicit sampling or continuity scope
qualification.physics: Separate state; kinematic rehearsal is not a force-driven execution certificate
qualification.admit_rule: All geometry, robot and appearance gates for the exact pair must pass; record physics status separately

random_generation.anchor_prior: balanced over released anchors conditional on family
random_generation.joint_proposal: condition geometry, grasp and trace proposal on the selected paired anchor
random_generation.failure_action: contract or locally replan, otherwise reject; never silently relabel as solved
random_generation.split_policy: group descendants by paired anchor/parent trace to avoid near-duplicate train/test leakage

milestones: Audit and finalize three macro seed route signatures, prioritizing F2/F3 separation
Qualify F1_U and F1_E, including controlled ellipse phase timing
Qualify F2_U, F2_E, F3_U and F3_E against their own family seeds
Release the nine paired anchors only after same-view visual review
Enable hierarchical random sampling with per-pair validation and balanced coverage
